summary.text: Emmanuel Findlay Jr. is the Conservative Party candidate for Assembly District 79 and has lost two earlier races, one for this seat in 2024 and one for New York City Council District 16 in 2025.

paragraphs.text: In the November 2024 general election for this Assembly seat, Findlay received 3.3% of the vote (841 votes) on the Conservative Party line, behind Chantel Jackson (D) and Sharon Darby (R).

In the November 2025 general election for New York City Council District 16, he received 11.4% of the vote (2,357 votes) running on the Republican and Conservative Party lines, losing to incumbent Althea Stevens.

For 2026, Findlay appears on the November 3 ballot on the Conservative Party line only; he withdrew from the Republican primary and advanced from the Conservative Party primary without appearing on the ballot.
